from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for path in paths:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        assert (path.parent / target.split('#')[0]).exists(), (path, target)
print('All links in changed documentation resolve.')
p = paths[0].read_text()
assert '[[fill:' not in p
assert [s for s in re.findall(r'^## (.+)$', p, re.M)] == ['Before you begin', 'Steps', 'If it fails']
print('Runbook sections and template completeness checked.')
